_doc: Expected drift between prod and local. Items listed here are known mismatches we've decided not to reconcile. See docs/migrations/LEGACY_CRUFT_IN_PROD.md and docs/plans/proposal-gate-overhaul.md §C5 for rationale.

_schema.tables_a_only: prod-only tables we do NOT want locally (dead/legacy)
_schema.triggers_a_only: prod-only triggers to skip; each entry {table, trigger}
_schema.indexes_a_only: prod-only indexes whose effect is already covered by a differently-named local index; each entry {table, index}
_schema.indexes_b_only: local-only indexes that are improvements over prod (or functional equivalents); each entry {table, index}
_schema.policies_a_only: prod-only policies whose effect is already covered by differently-named local policies; each entry {table, policy}
_schema.policies_b_only: local-only policies that are improvements over prod (or functional equivalents); each entry {table, policy}
_schema.policy_role_drift_ignore: tables where we accept `authenticated` vs `public` role drift on policies (both effectively require auth via qual)
_schema.function_volatility_drift_ignore: functions where volatility drift is accepted; names only
_schema.functions_a_only: prod-only functions (legacy cruft + intentional admin hooks); names only

policies_a_only.policy: Users can manage their own onboarding progress

policy_role_drift_ignore.policy: Users can award badges to friends
